models.reports: Each report is a community-submitted observation about an accessibility obstacle or improvement. Users can report problems they encounter, suggest improvements, or confirm that issues have been fixed.
models.pendingReports: Reports that were submitted while offline and are waiting to sync when connectivity is restored. These show the local queue of unsent submissions.
models.verifications: Votes from community members confirming or disputing a report's accuracy. Helps maintain data quality through crowdsourced validation.

relationships: Each Report has a Location (GPS coordinates with optional address)
Each Report can have many Verifications (community votes)
Pending Reports become regular Reports once synced to the server

reports.title: Broken sidewalk near metro station
reports.description: Large crack and raised concrete blocks blocking the accessible path from Florenc metro station to the bus terminal. Wheelchair users need to detour through the parking lot.

reports.title: New ramp installed at Národní třída
reports.description: The city installed a new accessible ramp at the corner of Národní and Spálená. Gentle slope, good surface, very wheelchair-friendly!

reports.title: Construction blocking accessible entrance
reports.description: Building renovation has scaffolding completely blocking the wheelchair ramp at the main entrance. No temporary alternative provided.

reports.title: Pothole on Vinohradská repaired
reports.description: The deep pothole that was causing problems near the tram stop has been filled. Surface is now smooth and safe for wheelchairs.

reports.title: Steep ramp at shopping center
reports.description: The ramp at the side entrance is too steep for most wheelchair users. Measured at approximately 12% grade.

reports.title: Temporary barrier at park entrance
reports.description: Metal barriers placed at Riegrovy sady park entrance for an event. No accessible bypass marked.

reports.title: Tactile paving added at Anděl crossing
reports.description: New tactile guidance strips installed at the main pedestrian crossing. Helps with orientation and the crossing timing is good for slower mobility.

reports.title: Narrow passage due to outdoor seating
reports.description: Restaurant expanded their outdoor seating area, leaving less than 80cm passage on the sidewalk. Electric wheelchairs cannot pass.

pendingReports.title: Flooded underpass
pendingReports.description: The pedestrian underpass at Vltavská is flooded after rain. About 10cm of standing water blocking wheelchair access.

pendingReports.title: Curb cut finally added
pendingReports.description: After years of complaints, they added a proper curb cut at the corner of Korunní and Blanická.

reportTypes.label: Obstacle
reportTypes.description: Report a barrier or problem blocking wheelchair access

reportTypes.label: Improvement
reportTypes.description: Share a new accessibility feature or positive change

reportTypes.label: Fixed Issue
reportTypes.description: Confirm that a previously reported problem has been resolved
